| # Digital inputs {#digital-inputs-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                 |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Besides the comparison of 2 independent signals described in [Multi-functional inputs in general](multi-functionalinputsingeneral.html){.topiclink}, failures of the digital inputs could be detected by implementing an application specific plausibility check of the machine function via the ASW.

For example, when using a travel direction switch with 3 position signals (forward, neutral and reverse), a single failure could be detected as indicated by the following table.

+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| Bit combination for                                           |                       |                                          |
|                                                               |                       |                                          |
| 3-position travel direction switch (forwards/neutral/reverse) | State in the ASW      | Comment                                  |
+===============================================================+=======================+==========================================+
| 0/0/0                                                         | Neutral               | Error, as one signal shall be active.    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| 0/0/1                                                         | Backward              | Normal operation.                        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| 0/1/0                                                         | Neutral               | Normal operation.                        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| 0/1/1                                                         | Neutral               | Error, as only one signal may be active. |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| 1/0/0                                                         | Forward               | Normal operation.                        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+
| 1/0/1                                                         | Neutral               | Error, as only one signal may be active. |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+                                          |
| 1/1/0                                                         | Neutral               |                                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+                                          |
| 1/1/1                                                         | Neutral               |                                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+

[]{#fig_45d9b9 .hmanchor}Table 26: Evaluation of travel direction switch
